content.text:
A ready hold now waits 10 days on the pickup shelf instead of 7. All 59 tests pass.

- **Code:** `PICKUP_DAYS` in `lib/holds/pickup.js` went from 7 to 10. Nothing else reads the number, so the hold-ready notice and the expiry run pick it up automatically. The existing rule still applies: if day 10 is a day the branch is closed, the deadline moves to the next open day.
- **Test:** I updated the pickup-deadline test in `test/holds.test.js` and renamed it to say 10 days.
  - A hold ready on 2026-11-19 now has a deadline of 2026-11-30. Day 10 is Sunday the 29th and Central is closed, so it moves to Monday.
  - A hold ready on 2026-11-15 now has a deadline of 2026-11-25.

This applies to holds that are already ready too, since the deadline is calculated from the ready date each time. Some holds that would have expired under 7 days will now stay open a few days longer.
